ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of high-intensity (off-white/light-grey) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A dominant, roughly triangular low-intensity black region occupies the central fluke area, narrowing toward the median notch. The distal lobes are predominantly high-intensity off-white. The right lobe (image-right) features a significant high-intensity field with dark, vertical-diagonal streaking near the inner edge. The left lobe (image-left) presents a more uniform high-intensity field with small, discrete dark clusters.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A sharp V-shaped central notch with a measured internal angle of approximately 92 degrees and moderate depth relative to the total lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Generally smooth trailing edge punctuated by micro-serrations at the distal tips. A small, distinct V-shaped indentation is visible on the superior edge of the left lobe approximately one-quarter distance from the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Both lobes exhibit a pronounced concave upward sweep from the notch toward the tapered, slightly rounded distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple small, roughly circular dark pixel clusters (spots) localized in the lower-mid quadrant of the left lobe and a larger, diffuse dark cluster on the inner mid-region of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Pronounced dark vertical-diagonal linear marks cutting across the high-intensity region of the right lobe; several finer, faint horizontal linear disruptions on the peripheral edge of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible small notch/indentation on the trailing edge of the left lobe near the tip; extensive dark pigmentation streaking on the inner right lobe likely indicating historical scarring or rake marks.
other_distinctive_markers: The boundary between the central black pigmentation and the light-colored lobes is highly irregular and exhibits high-contrast 'feathering' patterns.
